english: Didn't know?\fKagura comes equipped\nwith a MAP weapon.
Exactly.\fObstacles gone.\nLet's hit the backstreet...\fHuh? Where's\nthe glasses ninja?

Fwahahaha! See our formation?
Understand? Want to pass?
Battle each of us
and win your way through! No other way!
Huh? You... Wait...\nMAP? What?
AAAAAAH!!\nCome to think of it,\nonly I was talking!!
...\fGive up on that.\fEasy to obtain?\nThen it wouldn't\nbe a mystery.
Forgot my reward...\nThe mysteries\nof a woman's body.

Made a simple quiz
on me, Kagura, Sadaharu,
our adventures and memories. If you care about us
even a little,
you'll know every answer.
Yes! Proof of Our Bond!\nThe Yorozuya Quiz!\n...You'll try, right?
Proof of Our Bond!\nThe Yorozuya Quiz!\nReady to try it?
Refuse and you'll\ndoubt our bond, right?\fCan't back out\nafter you put it like that.

That's our Gin!
Let's get started!
Question one! Forgot to mention...
One wrong answer
and it's game over.
Obviously. Shinpachi,\nYOU underestimated\nour bond, didn't you?
As long as\nyou understand!\nI don't hold grudges.
Zzz...
Bound by strong ties\nand trust, aren't we!
Trusting that bond,\nhere. Take this!
Can I get paid soon?\nIf not money,\nat least rice or something...
Wait, Shinpachi!\nGoing on a journey?\nThere's no map for that!
Can't answer\nsuch an easy quiz...\nYou really don't care...
I'm shocked...\nHurt, so I'm leaving.\nTo the sea, perhaps...
Where was Sadaharu abandoned?
What food awakens Sadaharu?
Who's madly in love\nwith my sister Otae?
What's on the scroll\nhanging at Yorozuya?
Who won the three-person\nspace trip in\n[blue]Oedo Mart[/color]'s raffle?
Don't remember me like that.
What are YOU saying?!\fToday, I'm a customer!\nThe customer is God!
Yeah... Without a mate,\nSadaharu might\nget lonely too.
Heard something\nrather disturbing...
Anyway, a job's a job.\nLook for a guardian dog\naround town.\fGot it?
Huh? Your imagination!\nShrine maidens don't\nsnore away in bed!
Leave the dog hunt to us...\fAnd take a nap\nwhile we're busy, right?
Little Sadaharu...\nPoor thing...
Hit the nail on the head.
So you abducted\nKomako this time?
I keep telling you!\nAt least add 'Prince'!\nNo calling me an idiot!
Kidnapping?!\nDon't make it sound so bad!\nI love animals...

Too obvious, really.
Only the Idiot Prince
where Komako fled... Everyone knows
his obsession
with rare animals.
Classic useless adult!
Losing to that Idiot Prince?\nI'm disappointed!
Hmph. Just finding a dog.\nChild's play.
Don't let her escape\nagain. A sacred\nguardian, isn't she?
Nearly got killed, though.\nThat's what you get\nfor toying with Otsu.
Can't be helped.\nShowbiz really IS\nfull of country bumpkins.
Go to [blue]BUJI TV[/color]\nand maybe we'll\nmeet Ketsuno!
I regret that.\n...Oh! No time\nto dawdle!
A recording at\n[blue]BUJI TV[/color]'s outdoor studio.\nBut I seem to be lost...
Not really an enemy.
Wounds haven't healed, yes?
Don't say you forgot!\nThis is for Otsu!!
Kagura!\nQuit clicking your tongue\nso evilly!
Yes! This is\n[blue]BUJI TV[/color]!\nThank you. I owe you!
My apologies.\nLost my way...
Not you!\nOne person per pass.\nNo companions allowed.
Won't slip up this time.

Ladies and gentlemen!
Welcome to the feast
of underground Gin Tama! Who'll bloom
a grand rose tonight
in this bloodthirsty arena?!
A challenger steps up!\nA stage of fiery excitement!\nLET'S BEGIN!!!!
Such a small-fry line...\nI'll beat you\nat your own game!

Bastard...!
Perfect time for payback. Let my guard down
last time.
Not happening again!

Bastard...!
Perfect time for payback. Let my guard down
last time.
Not happening again!
Beat you again, then.
Such a small-fry line...\nI'll beat you\nat your own game!
I win.\nThe expected payback result.
...Just a knockout\ntournament. Winner gets\na top-quality Gin Tama.
Don't be rude!
Next one's waiting.\nSkip the parting threats!
So frustrating!\nAnd SO embarrassing!
Hahaha! How's losing\nto a small-fry feel?
Silence!\nThat top-quality Gin Tama\nwill aid my world conquest!
Good time to outgrow\nthose delusions\nof grandeur, isn't it?
Not about justice.\nJust ashamed I lost\nto a small-fry like you...
Finally got steady work.\nIsn't this bad for you?
Tch! I'll beat\nthat petty streak\nout of you today!\fBrace yourself! Here I come!!
But... Can't just\ngive up on a rare,\ntop-quality Gin Tama...

Can't win one
with skills like that. Quit dreaming.
Find a more ordinary
kind of happiness.
People grow up\nwhen they wake\nfrom their dreams.
Damn it!\nRemember this!
After all that boasting!\nI'll take\nthe top-quality Gin Tama.
Sorry to say...\nIt's game over.

She's Yato, right?
The legendary warrior clan? Perfect for [blue]Rengokukan[/color]'s
underground battles. And she works for Sukonbu!
Wonderfully cheap!
...No problem, then!
...Nothing left to say.\nNo mercy now!\nLet's fight, Kagura!
Twice as much this time!
So close! Damn!\nWinning would've\nearned me more Sukonbu...
Win them all\nand get more Sukonbu.\nFull of drive, yes!

Investigating Gin Tama
led me to this tournament. Came undercover...
Became champion
before I knew it. Odd fate.
Blinded by a prize,\nyou'd fight a friend?\nHow far you've fallen...
Careless...!
Say no more, Gintoki.\nGive nothing to the defeated,\nas they say.
...Heh.\nThe defeated simply vanish.\nFarewell, Gintoki.
Gin cost me\nmy bonus Sukonbu!\nYou deserved it!
Rude bastard...\fFine! Can't turn\nmy back after that!
Careless...!
Say no more, Gintoki.\nGive nothing to the defeated,\nas they say.
...Heh.\nThe defeated simply vanish.\nFarewell, Gintoki.

Sorry, but someone
wants to challenge you
after your seven wins. A man who insists
on fighting you.
Beat just one more\nand the top-quality\nGin Tama is yours.
Other way round, idiot!\nThat ugly face\nfired me up!\fI'll beat you senseless!!

Interested in
this Gin Tama craze.
For several reasons... Watching the rumored
underground battles...
Heh. A familiar face
was competing. Leave without
even saying hello?
Rather cold, wouldn't you say?
You never learn!\nWhat are you plotting?!
Of course I'll fight!\nI'll beat that rotten\nattitude out of you!
Heh. Can you?\nYou chose a listless\nordinary life.

...Gintoki, as expected.
Not so simple to beat. A shame. If only
you'd use those skills
for an ideal...

Don't move any further. My men are hidden
all over this arena. Try anything
and they won't stay quiet.
...People will die.

Hmph. Still
not ruthless enough.
Can't beat me like that. Abandoned your ideals
for a comfortable
ordinary life... A fitting ending. Disappointed, Gintoki.
...Goodbye.

Looking for Sorachi!
Deadline's near,
and he's run off... Find him fast
or there'll be a gap
in the serialization!
Oh, no!\n'Author ill.\nNo chapter this week'!
Quit those subtle\ndirty machinations!\n...Any idea where?
Quit scheming\nso quietly!
Deadline's near,\nand he's drinking\nwith girls around him?
Came all this way.\nOne drink?
Not here...\nOnishi comes\nalmost every day, though.
Have some shame!
N-no!\nEditing's exhausting!\nFatigue builds up...!!
Sensei! Come on!\nThe deadline\nis TODAY!
A very clear caricature.
Sorry! Forgive me!\nNature called\nto me. Couldn't resist...
Close, Gin.\nSo close...
Says 'Shienryu.'
Let's see...\f'Offer seven Dragon Tama.\nI will work a miracle.'\n...What do we do?
Worth a try.
Shienryu, huh...\fWait for me.\nI'll gather every\nDragon Tama and return!
What, Shinpachi?!\nThe Dragon Tama god\nwe've waited for is here!
...Shinpachi.\fLooks like a giant\nseahorse floating\nin the sky to me.
Gin...\nIt's getting dark...
Something flashed!
No, it's Shienryu.
With this atmosphere,\nSOMETHING is\ngoing to appear!
Think calmly, Gin!\fWhat would you do\nif a dragon suddenly\npopped up in front of you?!
Always nervous...
Something flashed.

I am Shienryu... For your courage
in gathering Dragon Tama,
I shall aid you. Speak your wish.
What do you desire?
Your wish...\fCharacter Select\nBattle mode...\fUnderstood.\nIt shall be granted.
For Character Select\nBattles, speak to\nthe one in Yorozuya's corner.
Dodged the question!
Your wish is granted...\fI return to sleep.\nIf you have courage,\ngather Dragon Tama again.\fFarewell.
...\fThat's the end\nof collecting Dragon Tama?\fNow it's over,\nfeels a bit lonely.

Now...
All your wishes
have been granted. I enter eternal sleep
with the Dragon Tama. We shall not meet again. Farewell.
D-don't be stupid!\nWhy mistake you\nfor a ghost...?
No way!\nI don't...\nbelieve in ghosts...
Fine...\nFind them before\nmore victims appear.
What a troublesome favor...
Sadako the Amanto!\nCaused a fuss\nlast time...
Huh? Did you just\nthink I was a ghost?
Sada: Mi/Yo/E,\nKiku/Ka/Na/Ri.
Sadako...\nHate that name.
Shinsengumi don't\nsearch for lost kids.
D-don't...\nNot funny\nwhen YOU say it.
From that ghost scare...
Refusing?\nMore people\nwill get their blood sucked.
W-wait...\nSadako's child, maybe?
Sadami, right...?\nYour mom's looking for you.\nGo home.
At night, by a hospital...\nAn eerie hand\nbeckoning from the shadows...
Yeah, I'm Sadami.
Glad, but irritated.\nMixed feelings.
It's okay.\nWon't suck a lethal dose.
Ghosts are...\nNot my specialty...
Protect you?\nWhat kind of ghost?
A ghost...?!
Waiting for Jennifer...\nSaw a ghost!!
A pale hand\nfrom the shadows...\nBeckoning to me...
Sadako?!\nOH MY GOD!!\nThe cursed video...?!
Isn't that Sadako's child?
Not free, you know.\nSadako's kid, right?
Yes. My name's Sadayo.
See you, Sada...
Can't remember\nseven kids' names...
Brush teeth.
Sadaharu!\nForgot already?
Kabukicho's dangerous.
All wrong. It's Sadayo.\nBye.
Take a bath.
What are you saying?\nSadakichi, I said.
Fine!\nI'll stay up\nALL night tonight!
Rowing an oar all night?
ALL NIGHT!\nStaying up to party!
Why row\nan oar all night?
Hey!\nYou're Sadako's kid, right?
Sadae! Fight!
S.E
Now go back\nto Sadako.

Fine...
You don't have to say
you're my father. I'm happy enough
just meeting you like this.
Sadako's kid?\nQuit hiding. Come out.
Quiet in the peanut gallery.
Sadakiku...\nLet's fight!
Sadako's kids\nlove Gin Tama battles, huh...
Kiku.
Trends matter, too.
But I drink\ntomato juice.
Hey, you.\nSadako's child, right?
Sadaka.\nNo alcohol.\nDrank blood, though... Hic!
Knows she's drunk, at least.
All of you, go home\nbefore you catch cold!
Zzz...
Quit that creepy\nbeckoning hand.
I'm big too.\nRoom feels cramped\nsometimes. I put up with it.
Sadana.\nDon't want to go\nback to that house...
Seven kids.\nHome's stifling.
But you've never\nbeen lonely, have you?
Lonely...?
